_how: Fill every value from the brief's checklist with its page as source, or keep the default and say 'assumption: why'. A value left null, or a source still in <brackets>, is skipped; a required one stops the script with its name.

map_scale.source: <the brief's site plan scale, with its page>

residents.source: <the brief's residents, with its page; only for green per resident on the design>

value.what: <something the brief keeps that no layer shows>

keep.source: <one page per item goes in its reason, e.g. 'trees protected (p. 28)'>

uses_from_site.source: assumption: the site layers that cover the ground, top first; land none covers is 'untagged'

street_widths_m.source: assumption: typical widths, used only where the site has no street-land layer

sealing.source: assumption: buildings and streets fully sealed, paved or gravelled grounds partly; ground under other uses unsealed

design_plot_m.source: assumption: the land within 15 m of a new building that no open space covers is its plot

green.source: assumption: OSM land uses grouped by what grows on them

walk_radii_m.source: assumption: about 5 and 10 minutes on foot

walk_side_m.source: assumption: land within 50 m of a reached path counts as reached

not_walkable.source: assumption: no footway along roads of these types

destinations.source: assumption: everyday destinations; 'design' says how the design's own features count

better.source: assumption: the first word of a measure says which way is better; missing means no verdict
